command: uv run python -m cubesat.benchmark --mode perf --base data/scenarios --report data/eval/perf_after_p1.json --repeats 3

websocket.method: uvicorn thread on 127.0.0.1:<ephemeral>, websockets asyncio client, POST /simulation/start with the speed, default 30 Hz emit cap

notes: Wall-clock timings, shared machine (see machine_busy, load). Median of repeats; min/max kept.
tick_ms_*, compute_s, setup_s: one instrumented run per repeat; the hook is a cancel_event stand-in stamping once per tick (setup_s = time before the first tick).
first_frame_s: start_live() to the first sim_state with satellites, in-process Session, min_emit_interval=0 (so the 30 Hz cap cannot hide it; the socket run keeps the cap).

inject_s: Session.inject_failure (DEAD, highest unscheduled sat id the replan accepts) to the first sim_state after it. The harness plays a fresh LiveStream to the stated percent off the clock (lookahead full), installs it as Session._source/_cursor/_last_frame_t (private) while the driver idles at speed 0.01; the inject is real.
variant=true rows: committed v1 scenario with engine overridden in memory. Engine v2 has no recovery (no replan) yet, so its compute excludes the allocator sweep that dominates v1.
cProfile inflates every number (deterministic profiler, one run): read the ranking only.
json_us is ONE encode per frame; the server encodes every message again per connected client.
